verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter's own docs describe end-to-end petition execution as its core service. It drafts the petition, legal brief and recommendation letters, then files the I-140 with USCIS. Letters are written for the client's specific story rather than templated, RFE responses are included at no extra cost, and one dedicated attorney handles the case start to finish. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of assembling an evidence binder or exhibit package, no explicit forms-preparation detail beyond the I-140 filing, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the service.
